basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old occupational therapist based in Toronto, Canada. I have a passion for vibrant hair colors and exploring new dye techniques, which is why I frequently visit the HairDye subreddit. I’m currently working at a local clinic specializing in physical therapy and rehabilitation, and I'm also pursuing further studies in the field, which brings me to PTschool discussions on Reddit. Balancing work and study can be tough, but I find solace in online communities. I'm single, and I usually spend my evenings and weekends browsing Reddit. Recently, I've developed an interest in exploring cultural nuances, which led me to AvatarTurkiye. I dislike unnecessary confrontations and prefer to keep my online interactions positive.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in occupational therapy, having completed my degree at a local university. My expertise is further enhanced by my hands-on experience at the clinic where I work. I keep myself updated with the latest in therapy techniques through self-study and by engaging with educational content on Reddit. My interest in hair dye is a hobby that I developed through trial and error, and I often share my experiences on related subreddits.
